summary: shell runs commands through /bin/sh on the target, unlike command. Prefer command unless shell features are needed, sanitize variables with the quote filter, consider script/template for inline scripts, and use win_shell on Windows.
questions: When should I use shell instead of command?
How do I prevent shell injection from variables?
How do I run shell commands on Windows?

answer_card.title: Run shell commands
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.shell` is like `command` but runs through `/bin/sh`, so pipes, redirects and env vars work.
- Prefer `command` unless you need shell features.
- Always use `{{ var | quote }}` for variables.
- For long inline scripts, consider `script` + `template`.
- Use `reboot` to reboot; `win_shell` on Windows.
- Encode non-UTF-8 output (e.g. `base64`).
